verdict.rationale: AMD documents a configurable power envelope (cTDP 45-120W) for the chip, which covers the 'documented power envelopes' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows sustained render or export performance, throttling behavior, or perf-per-watt testing. missing for 10: independent sustained-load or long-render testing, thermal and throttling data, performance-per-watt measurements, documentation of sustained versus boost behavior within the cTDP range.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt
